remarks: A Custom-Reimagined Home with Timeless Character, Modern Comfort  &  Exceptional Potential  Welcome to a distinctive Spanish Modern Mediterranean residence with a touch of vintage charm, thoughtfully reconstructed with longevity, functionality, and entertaining in mind. Offering approximately 2,120 square feet of living space, including a 750-square-foot addition, this exceptional property blends earthy finishes, natural textures, and inviting open-concept living. Listed by the assessor as a 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom home, while the floor plan reflects 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms.
